verdict.rationale: Docs show Marqeta's Core API letting a founder create card products, users, cards, spend/velocity controls, disputes, and webhooks via a sandbox quick-start (marqeta-docs-1,5,6,8,9,14), implying program management is handled by the platform. However, there is no explicit mention of BIN sponsorship or network membership arrangements, and no documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline metric anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/bank-partner language, network membership details, and a concrete time-to-live-card benchmark.
